meta.title: The Research — Bernard F. Pettingill, Jr., Ph.D.
meta.description: Selected publications from 1979 to 2025, each linked to a record outside his own websites, and further work listed on his CV.

sections.label: The Research
sections.quote: His research is not only historical. <t>The most recent paper here is from 2025.</t>
body: From a 1979 paper in Psychosomatics to 2025 work on hospital inflation, the thread is the same: what medical care costs, and how to project it honestly.
Each entry in the first list links to a record kept outside his own websites. The second list is taken from his curriculum vitae and says so.

sections.label: Selected publications
sections.title: Seven papers, <t>each with an outside record.</t>

items.t: The Resurgence of Hospital Inflation: Analysis and Implications for Forensic Practitioners
items.a: Sean P. Escoffery, Bernard F. Pettingill
items.v: Mega Journal of Case Reports, 8(1): 2001–2004, January 2025. Also published in Nursing & Primary Care, 9(1), 2025.
items.why: Medical inflation rates inside projections of future care costs.

items.t: The Physiatrist is Essential to Predicting Accurate Future Medical Care
items.v: International Journal of Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation, 13(S30).
items.why: How the treating physician's input shapes a life care plan projection.

items.t: Choosing the Correct Database for Measuring Life Expectancy
items.a: Bernard F. Pettingill, Jr., Sean P. Escoffery
items.v: Current Opinion, 4(6), 2024. His CV also lists it in The Forecast, National Association of Forensic Economics, Spring 2025.
items.src: Publisher link · page details pending verification
items.why: The life expectancy basis behind any lifetime damages figure.

items.t: The Role of Physiatrists in Ensuring Access to Appropriate Medical Care and Services in the Broken U.S. Healthcare System
items.a: Craig H. Lichtblau, Bernard F. Pettingill
items.v: International Journal of Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation, 12(4), 2024.
items.why: Access to care as a factor in what future treatment will cost.

items.t: Why Hospitals Resist Disclosing the Absolute Costs of Their Procedures
items.v: Journal of Clinical Medicine & Health Care, December 2024, per Crossref. His CV lists MEGA Journal of Case Reports, September 2024.
items.why: Hospital pricing opacity, a recurring problem when costing medical care.

items.t: Estimating the Full Value of Household Services Damages: Inclusion of Nighttime Protection and Care Services
items.a: James A. Mills, Bernard F. Pettingill
items.why: Valuing care and protection provided at night, often left out of household services claims.

items.t: Physicians’ Estimates of Disability vs Patients’ Reports of Pain
items.why: An early study of the gap between clinical assessment and patient experience.
